accepted.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
accepted.first_author_affiliation: EPFL / Swiss Data Science Center (EPFL and ETH Zurich)
accepted.scope: Implements exact Eq3 as a small fp32/fp64 tensor reference, causal/out-of-reach masking, positioned decoding parity and gradient controls. It materializes pair scores, not a sparse kernel. There is no FA3 block approximation, GQA cache allocator, trained decoder or throughput optimization. Frozen real-GPU validation is separate; CPU tests do not substitute for it.
accepted.cost_basis: The paper trains135M/360M models from scratch on2.7B/7.24B tokens using one H200 per run, with tuning, long-context continuation, a three-seed substudy and dense controls. The complete campaign is outside this short single-A100/A30 budget. The tensor component is expected to take under30seconds across three seeds, with no model/data downloads or API calls.
accepted.component_budget: At most30seconds/three seeds, zero model/data/API; exact small tensor reference.

accepted.title: Physics of Language Models: Part 4.2, Canon Layers at Scale where Synthetic Pretraining Resonates in Reality
accepted.scope: Review-only fixed-source documentation, figures, affiliation, code revision, cost and limitations. No Canon/GLA5/GDN2 implementation, metrics, GPU receipt or executable Evolve operator is added. A small convolution demo would not reproduce64 pretraining runs. The current byline is Allen-Zhu Research; experiments were conducted at FAIR at Meta and code is in facebookresearch, not proof of current Meta authorship.
accepted.cost_basis: The study contains64 from-scratch1.3B/3B/8B runs on1–2T Nemotron-CC tokens, multiple learning rates and evaluations. The paper estimates about100kUSD per8B run. This exceeds one A100/A30 or Mac budget; no checkpoint download or training probe is attempted.

accepted.title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
accepted.scope: Review-only production evidence, mechanism boundaries, original figure and cost. No local model, training/inference code, metrics, GPU receipt or Evolve operator. Public IBM/graph benchmarks do not supply the missing recipe or private training path. A small concatenation/MLP proxy would not reproduce this7B payment foundation model.
accepted.cost_basis: The industrial model has about6.92B parameters and1.74B active per route, private transaction/graph pretraining, multiple adaptations and a four-month production trial. Detailed training configuration is also withheld. A faithful low-cost single-A100/A30 reproduction is unavailable; no large model download or probe is attempted.
